name: Somchai Charoen
bio:
Somchai Charoen's journey to motorsport finance was unconventional. A career in accounting at a large Bangkok firm felt unfulfilling, even after 20 years. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, he volunteered at local racing events, gradually learning the financial intricacies unique to the sport. Realizing his passion outweighed his seniority, Somchai took a significant pay cut to pursue his dream, determined to bring his structured approach and unwavering loyalty to a world he deeply admires.

He believes in transparent budgeting, meticulous record-keeping, and fostering a collaborative environment where financial decisions are understood by all team members. While still developing his motorsport-specific knowledge, Somchai's dedication, work ethic, and willingness to learn make him a valuable asset. His calm demeanor and ability to remain level-headed under pressure are qualities that will serve him well in the high-stakes world of racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Somchai is of average height with a kind face and a slight build.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus for quick calculations, even though he uses spreadsheets.
Insists on brewing traditional Thai iced coffee for the team every Friday.
Has a collection of miniature race cars on his desk, each representing a significant motorsport victory.
